text:
anya: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp hit a weird embedding/rerank mismatch when using the batch helper from node vs python. Node returns 513-d vectors (trailing 0) while python returns 512. Also rerank endpoint errors with 'dim_mismatch'. Repro steps below.

sam: ugh. did we change padding? which SDK versions?

anya: node sdk v0.9.2, python sdk 0.8.6. sampleapp uses batch helper with pad_to_multiple=16. snippet:
```js
// node batch helper call
await client.embeddings.create({model:'embed-001', input: batch, pad_to: 513})
```

jordan: pad_to:513? looks like an accidental param from older helper. can you paste the raw response envelope?

anya: raw (sanitized):
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[...512 values...,0],"id":"1"}],"model":"embed-001"}
```

mike: that's the issue — node helper was appending a zero for an internal alignment bug. python trimmed. We'll patch.

olivia: also seeing auth retries cause duplicate embed calls when retry idempotency isn't set. user-facing bug in sampleapp: UI shows duplicate results.

mike: filed https://git.internal/rw/issue/4231 — fix: strip padding in helper and enforce vector length in client; add idempotency token for retries.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: hotfix/sdk-pad-fix -> staging at 15:30 UTC :gear:

sam: short-term workaround: run a post-process that trims trailing zeros and assert length==512 before sending to rerank.

anya: thanks. i'll patch sampleapp and add a small test. anyone want to review the PR? @mike @jordan

mike: can do. also let's add a parity e2e in CI that compares node/python embed shapes to catch regressions.

jordan: agreed. I'll add the CI job and a small flakey-tolerance check for auth-retry duplicates.

anya: perfect — i'll update the onboarding docs to call out pad params and the temporary retry idempotency note. :thumbsup:
